metadataRaw.title: 4 Best Exercises to Strengthen Your Core and Back (FOR LESS PAIN)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises you can do daily to help strengthen your core and back, which may help to lessen future pain and injury. 

Each exercise works a little differently, they're going to target different muscles. To get the best results, make sure to go through them all and use what works best for you.

As a bonus, all of the exercises can be done at home and require no equipment.
